limitations.role_scope: A5 (Loom) owner assessment and ratification of contracts A5 owns, starting with CTR-NTF-001 (the disposition's Q1: A5 assesses WP-0A-CON-006 open_blockers [1], [2], [19] and [22]; the disposition's sequence item 2, under WP-0A-CON-006). This run holds NO Author, Reviewer, Tester, Integration Owner, Product Owner, merge, or Gate G0 authority, and no Product/UX reviewer assignment on any package (role_assignments.product_reviewer_agent_run_id is unchanged wherever it is set). It must not author, review, test or integrate the work it assesses, and its assessment moves no contract's status by itself: the Draft -> Candidate move of CTR-NTF-001 is a separate PR, conditional on this run's signature and on A1's confirmation that SC-2 is met (disposition Q3).
limitations.benchmark_outcome: None yet. No capability benchmark exists for this run. The Product Owner directed a short, conditioned, forward-scoped benchmark by Q0 (disposition Q2), as was done for /claude/a6_relay (evidence/capability-benchmarks/a6-relay-billing-cost-ops.md). That benchmark must exist on main, and recommend this run for the A5 assessment, before this run signs as A5. Until then this declaration is not, by itself, a benchmark or an external approval.
limitations.same_lineage_disclosure: This run is spawned from the Author's run (/claude/a0_atlas), the same lineage as the author of the work it assesses. WP-0A-CON-006 open_blockers[1] records that A0 wrote the CTR-NTF-001 proposal A5 owns, and that ratification after the fact is a weaker and different control. The Product Owner accepted same-lineage ratification on condition that every A5 file carries a §0 disclosure of that lineage, and that A1, C0 and Q0 re-read the result (disposition Q4). A file of this run without that §0 disclosure is not an A5 signature.
